feeds.title: Wardsend Cemetery Heritage Park Blog
feeds.description: Read the blog to know the stories about the Wardsend Cemetery Heritage Park. Nestled on a wooded hillside, Wardsend Cemetery Heritage Park contains a unique Victorian cemetery, as well as a place for nature, art & performance and remembrance.

feeds.title: Lakewood Cemetery
feeds.description: News & Stories, with 150 years of history, art and gardens, and thousands of families connected to Lakewood, there is always something of interest to share. Lakewood has held reverent space for the lives and legacies of thousands of citizens from all walks of life. A history keeper and a thought leader, Lakewood honors its roots as a landmark cemetery while reimagining its role in modern life.

feeds.title: Cemetery Club
feeds.description: Burial Grounds are like libraries of the dead. Millions of people have ended up in these remarkable places and this blog seeks to highlight them, their achievements and the places where their mortal remains are. In May 2013 the Cemetery Club was founded. Stories of heroes and villains, inventors and actors, people who once lived, laughed, loved and cried.

feeds.title: VFC News
feeds.description: Read our blog to know what makes Vermont Forest Cemetery unique. Vermont Forest Cemetery is Vermont's first Natural Burial Cemetery dedicated to the restoration and conservation of Vermont forestland. We pride ourselves on being accessible and affording- offering economically and environmentally sustainable burial options to all people.

feeds.title: Gethsemane Cemetery and Memorial Gardens Blog
feeds.description: Gethsemane Cemetery and Memorial Gardens' blog helps people deal with the sorrow of losing a loved one and gives advice on planning the cremation or burial. Gethsemane Cemetery and Memorial Gardens is the perfect scenic setting where families and friends can celebrate life. In 1975, we set out to design a resting place unlike any other.

feeds.title: Adventures in Cemetery Hopping
feeds.description: Hi, I am Traci Ryland and my blog talks about the different cemeteries I have visited. As a student at the University of Georgia, I took obituaries over the phone at the Athens Daily News. I have met many funeral directors over the years and am comfortable with the subjects of death, funerals and cemeteries.

feeds.title: Cemetery Travel
feeds.description: Cemetery Travel: Your Take-along Guide to Graves & Graveyards Around the World. My fascination with graveyards goes way back. I'm Loren Rhoads and I grew up down the road from a country graveyard where my grandfather was buried. After a series of missed connections during the First Gulf War, I ended up in London's glorious Highgate Cemetery. From that point on, I was hooked.

feeds.title: Wyuka Funeral Home & Cemetery Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Historic Wyuka Cemetery. Wyuka is listed on the National Registry of Historic Places and was designed to preserve the rich history of the original grounds. For over 140 years, Wyuka Cemetery has played an integral part in the lives of Nebraskans. It is known to be the largest all-faith cemetery serving the Lincoln community.

feeds.title: Gethsemane Cemetery
feeds.description: Stay up-to-date with with latest news and information about the Gethsemane Cemetery. For a Catholic, burial in a Catholic cemetery is a final act of faith. Gethsemane Cemetery has facilitated Catholic family and friends' burials for over 120 years, with room for burials well into the next century.

feeds.title: Associated Catholic Cemeteries Blog
feeds.description: The Associated Catholic Cemeteries blog is a useful resource for anyone that need information regarding burials or cremations of their loved one. The Catholic cemetery is the final resting place for the members of our Faith Community on our Journey to God.

feeds.title: Mount Holly Cemetery Blog
feeds.description: The Mount Holly Cemetery blog give you news, information, and history about the cemetery and its land. On February 23, 1843, prominent Little Rock businessmen Roswell Beebe and Chester Ashley deeded four blocks to the young city of Little Rock for use as a cemetery. Mount Holly has been referred to as the 'Westminster of Arkansas' because of the number of famous Arkansans buried here.

feeds.title: Friends of Eastern Cemetery Blog
feeds.description: Read the Friends of Eastern Cemetery blog to find out more about the restoration process of the cemetery. Friends of Eastern Cemetery is a non-profit volunteer group aiming to restore and maintain Eastern Cemetery. After being abandoned in 1989, Eastern Cemetery soon became a mangled, desperate sight right in the heart of the city. The Friends of Eastern Cemetery was formed to change that.

feeds.title: Old City Cemetery Blog
feeds.description: Check out the Old City Cemetery blog for updates from the cemetery including events and news. Established in 1806, Old City Cemetery is the oldest public cemetery in Virginia still in use today. It is the most visited historic site in the City of Lynchburg and is Central Virginia's most unique public garden.

feeds.title: Historic Linden Grove Cemetery & Arboretum Blog
feeds.description: Know about the recent events that happened in the Historic Linden Grove Cemetery & Arboretum by reading the blog. Historic Linden Grove Cemetery & Arboretum offers a parklike space with a purpose. It's where history, community, and nature meet.

feeds.title: Bayer Cemetery Brokers Blog
feeds.description: Read the blog to get the latest news from Bayer Cemetery Brokers. With over 30 years of combined experience, our cemetery brokers offer the residents of Southern California professional guidance for making decisions regarding one's legacy.

feeds.title: Congressional Cemetery Blog
feeds.description: Congressional Cemetery is a vibrant and active community with lots of news to share. Check out our blog for updates on events and more! Congressional Cemetery preserves, promotes, and protects our historic and active burial ground. We respectfully celebrate the legacy of those interred here through education, historic preservation, community engagement, and environmental stewardship.

feeds.title: The Cemetery Traveler Blog
feeds.description: I'm Ed Snyder and I began this blog in order to share my decade-long experience with all things cemeterial. As a photographer specializing in images of cemetery statuary, I've run into some interesting people, had some unexplainable experiences, and had a lot of fun.

feeds.title: Oakland Cemetery Blog
feeds.description: Get to know the stories of the Historic Oakland Cemetery, Atlanta's oldest public park and the final resting place of many of the city's most noted citizens. Founded in 1850, Oakland Cemetery is one of Atlanta's largest public parks and a unique oasis of history, sculpture, botanical gardens and wildlife.
